newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -BTPs in better shape, next goal 129.12.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -BTPs in better shape, next goal 129.12.

text.p: June BTPs are poised for more gains after recently taking out a trendline at 128.76, setting up a near-term channel resistance target of 129.12, analysts said on Wednesday.
"The 128.76 level is a trendline we need to sustain a break of," said Elizabeth Miller, technical analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell. "That's drawn off the high near 131.80 from January."
The LIFFE futures set a 131.76 contract high on January 23.
June BTPs at 0721 GMT were just above the trendline, trading at 128.77, down 0.06. They have been moving either side of it during the session so far.
Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures in London, said the recent break of 128.40, which was a high on May 2, had led to the breakthrough above the downtrend resistance line.
"This is a further bullish development confirming the recent action as a continuation from which further upside can develop over the coming days," Adcock said in a note to clients.
June Eurolire were at 93.26, down 0.01 from the prior close.
